notes.title: What's next | New Map | Player Feedback
notes.content:
[b]Hi everybody,[/b]

First of, I want to thank everyone who played DHP in its first month. I hope you had some fun and found some charm in its gameplay. Thank you very much, it means a lot to me.

[b]Feedback and future content[/b]

As you surely can guess, DHP is not a big seller here on steam and its player base is, at this point, very small. But since this game doesn't need to be a big seller, its further development can fully focus on the players that do like this game, in one way or another. So I would like to know more about your thoughts about future content or improvements.

That's why I will create some discussion within the community hub including:
- General Feedback
- Future Content
- Bug Report

Feel free to share your thoughts and I do my best to respond quickly. But please notice I am developing this alone and I got a full-time job on the side, so it may take up to a few days for an answer. I am excited to read from everyone who is willing to share their thoughts.

[b]New Map[/b]

With the update, a new map will be added to the private session map selection. A silent, eerie cave with the hell-match-mode in third and first person version. I hope you like it as much as we had fun testing it. It almost feels a bit like a horror-style pvp experience. 

[b]Jungle hell map now unlocked from start[/b]

Maybe it was not the smartest idea to force people to wait alone on a pvp map to unlock a new map. Sorry to everyone who had to sit through it. The map will now be available right away for everyone. The text-part within the product description will be removed after the patch launched as well.

[b]That's of for the most part[/b]

Only other things that changed is some explanations that are added to the main menu buttons.

[b]1.0.0.6 release date[/b]

I am planning on putting this update live within the next 2-4 weeks

Thank you very much, Dev
